slate_notes: Pregame snapshot, written ~4:55 PM ET; the slate has not started (first tips 7:00 PM). 10 legs, all different players from the morning file: NBA x7 (7 legs across 6 games), NHL SOG x2 (MTL@NYR, VAN@UTA), NFL MNF x1. The only shared game is PHI@BKN (Randle U3PM for BKN, Simons U reb for PHI, opposite teams; avoid both in one slip). No college props. Every est_prob is a multiplicative two-way devig at the exact half-point line using WinDaily best-of-book prices, shaded down 1.5-3.5 pts. WinDaily still showed its 9:00 AM ET stamp, so the prices may predate afternoon news. Avg est_prob 0.577. Dropped despite good prices because the game logs contradicted them: Danny Wolf U1.5 3PM (2+ in 5/7), Tari Eason U1.5 3PM (6/10), Wiggins U1.5 3PM (5/10), Giddey U1.5 3PM (5/10), Dean Wade U1.5 3PM (3 straight 2+ at 34-35 min), Justice Hill U2.5 rec (3+ in 5/9). Also dropped Larsson (DTD), Trae Young U2.5 3PM (unexplained 0-pt, 26-min game last night on a back-to-back), Clowney (sudden 35-min role), and low-hold or stale quotes (Kuminga, Jalen Green, Avdija, McDaniels). Also skipped 0.5 goals/assists unders, which are usually Goblins on the apps. PrizePicks/Underdog app lines are UNCONFIRMED. Nothing from the morning run is gradable yet (all tonight).
